feedback:
Accept - physics sound and buildable retrofit.

Model check: 10,000 kg modal mass for 40m footbridge is reasonable. mu=500/10000=5%. Den Hartog tuning 1.9/(1+0.05)=1.81 Hz matches E3, damping ~13.36% matches optimum, stiffness k=500*(2pi*1.81)^2~64.6 kN/m matches E3. Statics: 250kg=2452N E10, sag 76mm E11 =2452/32.3kN/m correct. Dynamics: k_modal~1.43 MN/m, 1400N static 0.98mm x 1/(2*0.004)=122mm -> omega^2*x=17.5 m/s2 uncontrolled matches E6, x 1/(2*0.0944) ->0.74 m/s2 controlled matches. 9.44% effective and 20mm travel plausible for 5% TMD and corroborated by prior art 1.5%->9.0% Malmo. Units/regime correct.

Load path valid: crowd -> deck antinode -> clamp beams -> springs/dampers -> TMD masses. Signal path valid: midspan accelerometer -> conditioner -> sweep analyzer for 1.81Hz tuning -> Setra/Hivoss check. No conservation violation.

Buildable: all parts purchasable - steel block, coil springs (~32kN/m each), viscous dampers (~760 Ns/m each per unit, GERB/Vibratec range), SHS 100x6, M20 U-bolts, hatches. Ordinary methods: off-site pre-assembly, U-bolt clamp no welding to host, night under-deck scaffold, soffit paint. Stress 16.5MPa E14 << steel allowable, slip factor 14.6 E15 ample. Concealment below soffit with zero deck hardware meets 'no deck look change'.

Prior art proves class: Vibratec Bagers Plats 2x340kg at 1.85Hz midspan 1.5%->9% comfort met, GERB helical+viscous vertical footbridge range, DEICON 500kg combined midspan underneath concealed - same principle/architecture/application. Your point differs only in 2x250kg 1.8095Hz 0.4%->9.44% 0.74m/s2 CL2 20mm + SHS U-bolted clamp + hatch kit, which is credible detailing.

Remaining non-blocking for detailed design: (1) Eurocode check host cross-girders for 2x250kg static+dynamic TMD force, (2) link 30kN U-bolt preload to slip with serrated plates, (3) confirm CL2 <1.0 at 0.74 vs CL1 <0.5 accepted as retrofit comfort, (4) provide vertical guides/lateral restraint so hung coils act vertically, ensure under-bridge clearance.
